test_title: PYST 25: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 2nd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: W, X, Y and Z are playing cards. Y is sitting at the right side of X, who is at the right side of W. Who is sitting at the right side of Y?
solution:
**Given : W, X, Y and Z are playing cards.**

Explanation :

**⇒As they are playing cards, therefore all of them are sitting in a circular manner and also will be facing towards the center.**

1) Y is sitting at the right side of X.​​​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f93ff7d9cfba51c93ed9944ea2ce72d677efe9aea9fabbf431a519a1466da94.png] 

2) Y is sitting at the right side of X, who is at the right side of W.

After positioning W only one position is left, which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d4461c1e093028b14087eefef6588eb15ee0835303fb2bdb5d0e8a2d5fca4f9.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Z is sitting at the right side of Y.

Hence, **"Z"** is the correct answer.
